.DISCUSSION...

...Yellowstone NP and Teton dispatch areas (includes fire weather 
zones 140...414...415...and 416)...

Scattered rain showers in lower elevations to mountain snow in
higher elevations expected throughout the day today. Gusty
southwest winds up to 25 to 35 mph expected with humidity values
down to the 20 to 30 percent range widespread. A cold front will
push through the zones between 16-1800L shifting winds more
northwesterly and diminish through midnight. Mixing and smoke
dispersal will be very good due to the strong winds.

282...283...285...286...287...288...and 289)...

higher elevations expected throughout the day today for zones

with humidity values down to the 20 to 25 percent range 
widespread. A cold front will push through the zones between 
16-1800L shifting winds more northwesterly and diminish through 
midnight. Mixing and smoke dispersal will be very good due to the 
strong winds.

279...280...281...285...289...and 300)...
